verdict.summary: The exact PR head is blocked by incomplete acceptance provenance and a validation-duty contradiction affecting Autoreview fix profiles.

blockingFindings.title: Release issue contracts are absent from the review context
blockingFindings.details: The release declares closure work items #280, #360, #364, #380, and #396, but the supplied exact-head context contains linkedIssues: []. The engine-automation path bypasses the normal linked-issue requirement without fetching the release issues as bounded untrusted review data. Consequently this review cannot map the 19 changed paths to their acceptance criteria or independently establish complete release coverage, which the acceptance-driven and missing-provenance policies require before approval.

blockingFindings.title: Validation policy assigns an impossible duty to PR autofix turns
blockingFindings.details: The revised shared skill says every non-review profile retains its declared validation duties. profile/pr-fixer is a non-review profile whose role declares that it reruns validation, but Autoreview invokes it through the read-only untrusted-target model boundary and its output schema can only return replacement-file proposals; exact-head command execution belongs to the separate Validate lane. This contradictory instruction can cause fix turns to block, make unverifiable validation claims, or emit malformed output. Distinguish Autoreview fix profiles from implementation profiles and add coverage for the fixer composition, not only reviewer and implementer compositions.
